description: Test harness and helper functions for sanitizing session history in the pi-embedded-runner module, including mock session managers, message creation, and scenario setup.

methods.name: makeModelSnapshotEntry
methods.description: Creates a session entry object representing a model snapshot with optional timestamp.

methods.name: makeInMemorySessionManager
methods.description: Creates a mock session manager with predefined entries, supporting getEntries and appendCustomEntry methods.

methods.name: makeMockSessionManager
methods.description: Creates a mock session manager with no initial entries.

methods.name: makeSimpleUserMessages
methods.description: Generates a simple array of user message objects.

methods.name: loadSanitizeSessionHistoryWithCleanMocks
methods.description: Loads the sanitization function with mocked helpers, resetting modules and mocks.

methods.name: makeReasoningAssistantMessages
methods.description: Creates assistant messages with reasoning thinking signatures, optionally JSON formatted.

methods.name: sanitizeWithOpenAIResponses
methods.description: Calls the sanitize session history function with predefined parameters for OpenAI responses.

methods.name: expectOpenAIResponsesStrictSanitizeCall
methods.description: Asserts that the sanitize session messages images mock was called with specific parameters.

methods.name: makeSnapshotChangedOpenAIReasoningScenario
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with a model snapshot entry and reasoning assistant messages.

methods.name: sanitizeSnapshotChangedOpenAIReasoning
methods.description: Performs sanitization on a scenario with a changed OpenAI reasoning setup.
